candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to return 502 and gateway checkout to fail with 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side telemetry; payment 503 root cause (config, saturation, crash) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory reservation succeeds (200) while payment returns 503, order returns 502, and gateway checkout returns 502. Gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). Root cause is downstream of order at payment, but payment-side evidence is absent, so the bounded candidate is the 5xx failure chain rather than a specific payment fault.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/traces/metrics for POST /v1/authorizations showing why it returns 503
Order service telemetry to confirm 502 originates from payment failure propagation
